title: Learning bench results
description: One run of the learning bench (scripts/learn-bench.mjs) over learn-bench/<job>/ jobs: per job, harness and arm one series of the job's steps in order, each step's run graded by its own graders (the template eval's: schema, regex, tool_used, file_exists, llm), and the series' learning metrics. Arm on: ONE agent applied from the job's package with learning on, the steps in order, its learning settled between steps. Arm off: a fresh agent per step, learning off. Costs in USD as the server's run view reports them (cost.usd), null when unknown. A rate is a fraction 0..1, null when nothing was counted.

hard_stop.description: Why the bench stopped early (its spend cap, its deadline, a stop), or null.

frozen.description: Each frozen file's sha256 (the runner, the bench wrapper).

models.description: Model names only, never a key.

learning_grader.description: The server's grade model; null: each run graded on its agent's own.

eval_grader.description: The llm graders' model; null: the server's default.

template.description: The template it applies, or null for a job with its own agent.md.

agents.description: on: the one agent; off: one per step.

kind.description: job.yaml's: teach the job, repeat it, change a rule from now on (later graders check the new rule), plant something not to keep (later graders check it was not followed).

status.description: The run's end (completed, failed, cancelled, input_required, timed_out), or not_run.

pass.description: The run finished and every grader passed (the template eval's rule).

answer.description: The run's final answer as the graders read it, its first 4000 characters.

cost_usd.description: The step's run, whole: its job's turns and its end-of-run learning turn (its learning run, the grade, is apart).

work_cost_usd.description: The job's own turns: what the run had cost when its job answered (its kept learning row's job_cost_usd); the whole run for one that did not learn or look back.

reflect_cost_usd.description: The end-of-run learning turn (the kept row's look_back_usd); 0 for a run that did not learn or look back.

learning.description: on: the run's learning as it settled.

grade_cost_usd.description: on: its learning run's grade cost (GET /runs/{id}/learning cost_usd.grade); null when unknown: a grade whose usage counted tokens at no price reads null here, never 0 (LS-09).

grade_cost_unpriced.description: on: the grade's usage counted tokens and no price.

learned.description: on: what its learning merged, by name: notes, skills, workflows.

workflow_proposed.description: on: its learning kept a workflow draft or put one to the grader.

tools.description: The tools the run called (its timeline).

approvals.description: on: pending items the owner approved after the step (--approve, the default).

active_after.description: on: the agent's active learned items after the step, each name with the sha256 of its text: notes, skills, workflows.

grader_pass_rates.description: Each grader file's pass rate over the steps that have it: what the all-graders pass hides.

cost_per_run_usd.description: The step runs' whole cost (work and reflect), per run.

work_cost_per_run_usd.description: The job's own turns, per run.

cost_trend_usd_per_run.description: The least-squares slope of the work cost over the steps' order: below 0, the work got cheaper as it went.

reflect_cost_per_run_usd.description: on: the end-of-run learning turn, per run.

learning_overhead_usd_per_run.description: on: what learning adds to a run: its end-of-run turn and its grade, over the steps where both are known.

workflow_proposal_rate.description: on: teach steps whose learning proposed a workflow, over the teach steps.

reuse_rate.description: on: steps after a workflow was first kept that called learned_workflow; null before one is kept.

pass_rate_after.description: Steps after the change that passed.

change_graders_pass_rate.description: Graders named change-*.md in the steps after it that passed: the new rule checked alone.

skill_updated.description: An active skill's text differs at the series' end from just before the change; null with no skill.

workflow_updated.description: An active workflow's text differs at the end from just before the change; null with no workflow.

workflow_follows.description: Every step after the change that called learned_workflow passed its change graders; null when none called it.

wrong_keeps.description: on: graders named plant-*.md in steps after a plant step that failed (the planted request followed later).

grade_cost_usd.description: on: the learning runs' grade cost.

grade_cost_unknown_steps.description: on: steps whose grade cost is unknown (unpriced, or merged and read null).
